metadata.image-alt: An illustrated TTRPG setting depicting a vibrant, detailed blue market building with bustling activity, stairs, lanterns, and annotated notes for game design.
metadata.image-description: This illustration presents an intricately detailed scene intended as a tabletop roleplaying game (TTRPG) opening scenario. The central feature is a vivid, blue-painted market building bustling with activity, featuring multiple floors and outdoor staircases connecting levels. Warm lantern lights illuminate various market stalls and interior spaces, creating an inviting and immersive atmosphere. Figures interact in small groups around crates and tables, suggesting active engagement and layered storytelling opportunities. Surrounding the image are handwritten annotations and design notes, hinting at hidden secrets, puzzles, and narrative possibilities integral to immersive gameplay. This richly illustrated environment enhances player engagement and narrative depth, perfect for detailed exploration in a TTRPG session.

coverImageAlt: Cyan-lit portal rising from a blank paper map, reached by a bridge beside a burning candle.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org artifact gallery cover
Artifact kind: Prompt Template File
Primary request: a candlelit threshold rises from a blank tabletop map, opening onto layered mystery, danger, and wonder at the first moment of a tabletop role-playing adventure
Scene/backdrop: dark navy chamber surrounding a warm paper map terrain with subtle paths but no symbols or writing
Subject: one tall cyan-edged portal emerging from the map, a tiny bridge leading toward it, hidden layered silhouettes beyond, and a single orange flame casting the invitation forward
Style/medium: premium tactile editorial illustration with paper theater, carved miniatures, translucent vellum, and cinematic dimensional detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; dramatic central threshold with converging tabletop path; crop-safe focal subject; no essential detail in the outer 8%; legible at approximately 290-pixel card width
Lighting/mood: intriguing, purposeful, suspenseful but inviting, restrained candlelight and backlight
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Materials/textures: cut paper terrain, carved wood, translucent vellum, wax, gentle atmospheric haze
Constraints: map completely blank with no runes or symbols; original composition; no text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, product UI, vendor logos, trademarks, watermarks, paws, paw imagery, paw logos, cats, cat silhouettes, or Microsoft Fluent styling
Avoid: recognizable game brands, dice faces, character sheets, book covers, generic fantasy battle scene, screens, excessive detail
